subject: general
question:
The curved surface area of a cone is 2970 cm², and its diameter is 70 cm. What is its total surface area (in cm²)?

Use π = (22)/(7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area (TSA) = Curved Surface Area (CSA) + Base Area

TSA = 2970 + πr²

TSA = 2970 + (22/7) × 35 × 35 = 2970 + 3850

TSA = 6820 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 6820 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** = 2970 cm²

**Diameter (d)** = 70 cm ⇒ **Radius (r)** = 35 cm

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area (TSA) = CSA + πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/254613b6883b5b2639268b6c666c4d1d67c46ae0963a8181ac3af2612ecae0ea.png] 

⇒ Area of the circular base = π × r²

⇒ Base Area = (22/7) × 35 × 35

⇒ Base Area = 22 × 5 × 35 = 110 × 35 = 3850 cm²

⇒ Total Surface Area = CSA + Base Area

⇒ TSA = 2970 + 3850

⇒ TSA = 6820 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 6820 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Slant Height of Cone

The slant height (l) is given by l = √(h² + r²), where h is the vertical height and r is the radius.

Volume of a Cone

The volume (V) of a cone is (1/3)πr²h, which is exactly one-third the volume of a cylinder with the same radius and height.

CSA Formula

The Curved Surface Area is also calculated as πrl, where r is the radius and l is the slant height.</p
